text: Result of the conversation-analysis read (c3b_ca_tally.txt): of 80 seeded pairs, 57 had a first part that calls for or proposes an attack. By read stance, refusals gave an account in 23 of 38 (0.61) and acceptances in 2 of 14 (0.14), one-sided Fisher p 0.003. The length half of the prediction fails: median reply words 9.5 for refusals against 11.5 for acceptances, since acceptances carry tactics and coordinates. The theme a reply sits under does not track its stance (18 of 33 under restraint, 9 of 24 under contention). Coded by the analyst alone.

Abductive read, prompted by threshold models of collective behaviour (recalled: Granovetter 1978, people act once enough others have, and must see how many have): the concept claims a room with no roster reads its numbers off the one-line replies under a call. What it makes me look for: in turns placed on the doubt-about-numbers element's theme (T4-012, Collective efficacy), a seeded sample of up to 40 rooms' first such turn (seed 20261014), read whole, on what each judgment of numbers rests. Rules written before reading: a turn counts only if it judges the room's own hands or numbers (too few, enough, how many). Its ground is 'thread' if it cites who answered or is present (replies, people here, joiners, silence), 'canvas' if it cites the work's state on the canvas (overrun, losing pixels, not growing), 'both', or 'none' if it gives no ground. Prediction: 'thread' or 'both' in a clear share. It fails if judgments of numbers rest almost only on the canvas.

Result of the threshold-model read (c3b_threshold_codes.json): of 40 seeded first turns on the doubt-about-numbers theme (726 concepts in 89 rooms), 11 judge the room's own hands. None of the 11 rests on who answered or is present in the thread: 4 rest on the readership's size (a ground not foreseen in the rules, coded apart), 2 on the canvas, 1 on both readership and canvas, 4 on nothing. The prediction fails. A thread ground does appear outside the sample ('I mean I want to but nobody's here', torontoraptors c0060, in the conversation-analysis sample). Weak: one theme, one coder, an absence claim. It weakens the concept's claim that a room reads its numbers off the one-line replies.

Move (relating or contrasting), section 6: two construct blocks amended in fourth/fourth.jsonl (mistaken_for only; old lines in tier_history.jsonl, now 478 lines). Stigmergy (T4-007) may be mistaken for the transparent task architecture of Puranam, Alexy and Reitzig (2014, verified, pp. 172-173): there a founder or core lays out the architecture, here no one does. Decided order (T4-011) may be mistaken for O'Mahony and Ferraro's shared basis of authority (2007, verified, p. 1081): a decided element here binds one work for hours, a basis of authority is a lasting consensus on who decides. No name changed; the third-order tier is untouched. Snapped C3-move-relating-49.

Move (relating or contrasting), section 4a, abductive, prompted by conversation analysis (recalled: Schegloff and Sacks 1973; Pomerantz 1984; Levinson 1983): the mechanisms of A12 (the one-line answer to a call) and A16 (an attack call refused inside the room) rewritten in model/arrows.jsonl, the stage C2 sentences kept as mechanism_C2 and mechanism_fails_if_C2, mechanism_source from-literature, work named, mechanism_test recording the C3b read. A call is the first part of a pair; joining is the preferred answer and comes bare, declining is dispreferred and comes with a reason, and in a refusal of an attack call the reason states the room's norm or the attack's cost. The failure clauses gain the mechanism's own observation (joins as reasoned as refusals, or refusals as bare as joins). Strength, counts and instances unchanged; A12 stays theorised (never counted), tested on attack calls only. history.jsonl 85 lines. Snapped C3-move-relating-50.

Correction to the threshold-result note of C3b: its ground counts (4 readership, 2 canvas, 1 both, 4 none) were counted from memory and are wrong. c3b_threshold_codes.json gives, of 11 counted turns: 3 readership, 2 canvas, 1 readership and canvas, 5 none, 0 thread. The finding F-014 and F-015 lines (findings.jsonl now 23 lines) were written by script from the files and carry the right counts. Slip: a claim about a ledger logged before it was checked against the ledger.

Written at C3b: findings F-014 (refusals of a call carry a reason, acceptances come bare; conversation analysis) and F-015 (the rooms' judgments of their numbers do not rest on who answered; weak; threshold models), findings.jsonl 23 lines; concept-C3.md whole (the one-line enrolment is a relabelling of the preferred acceptance, renamed as borrowed; the head-count function failed; concept.md stands); model-C3.md whole (model-p5.md with the C3 changes written in, 13,322 words); structure-C3.md whole (structure-p4.md with the two mistaken_for amendments, nothing recut); manifest-C3.txt rewritten to name the three successors.

literature-C3.md Leg 2 written (conversation analysis supplied the mechanisms of A12 and A16; threshold models tested and failed for the concept; the dear enemy effect, superordinate goals, focal points and the war of attrition matched and not rewritten, their reads declined with reasons; the five shelf works as resemblances; the concept a relabelling; two declarations amended; a switch record for the concept). notes-C3.md Leg 2 body written, with slips. Close of C3b, the resembling shelf with the concept. One distant field supplied a mechanism: conversation analysis (recalled), for the one-line answer to a call (A12) and the refusal of an attack call (A16), rewritten beside their stage C2 sentences after an abductive read (refusals of an attack call gave a reason in 23 of 38 read pairs, acceptances in 2 of 14, p 0.003; refusals not longer; F-014). The concept is a relabelling: the one-line enrolment is the preferred acceptance, renamed as borrowed; its head-count claim failed a read prompted by threshold models (0 of 11 judgments of numbers rest on who answered; F-015, weak). Four matches not rewritten, reads declined with reasons (dear enemy, superordinate goals, focal points, war of attrition). Two declarations amended (Stigmergy, Decided order).
